headline: Datadog Director Amit Agarwal Sells 20,000 Shares for $5.2 Million
summary: Insider exercised stock options and sold shares under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan established in March, reducing his equity stake by 35% while retaining nearly 900,000 derivative securities.
